/.title: The University of Chicago
/.description: One of the world’s leading research universities, the University of Chicago inspires scholars to pursue field-defining research, while providing a transformative education for students.

/who-we-are.title: Who We Are | University of Chicago
/who-we-are.description: The University of Chicago is an urban research university that has driven transformative leadership in education since 1890. Our commitment to free and open inquiry draws inspired scholars to our global campuses, where ideas are born that challenge and change the world.

/who-we-are/community-impact.title: Community Impact | University of Chicago
/who-we-are/community-impact.description: The University of Chicago community stretches beyond our campus borders in Hyde Park. We are deeply embedded in the city of Chicago, especially with our neighbors across the South Side.

/who-we-are/global-impact.title: Global Impact | University of Chicago
/who-we-are/global-impact.description: The University began on the South Side of Chicago but has become a global research institute at home in every corner of the globe.

/who-we-are/history-and-traditions.title: History and Traditions | University of Chicago
/who-we-are/history-and-traditions.description: Since our inception, the University of Chicago has broken with tradition and followed a distinctively different path to build an enduring legacy.

/who-we-are/facts-and-figures.title: Facts and figures | University of Chicago
/who-we-are/facts-and-figures.description: Learn more about the University of Chicago’s demographics, higher education statistics, and university ranking through these quick facts and figures.

/academics.title: Academics | University of Chicago

/academics/schools-and-divisions.title: Schools and Division | University of Chicago
/academics/schools-and-divisions.description: Explore UChicago’s degree and academic programs across the undergraduate College, four graduate divisions, seven professional schools, and the Graham School of Continuing Liberal and Professional Studies.

/research-and-scholarship.title: Research and Scholarship | University of Chicago
